description: TI TPS61023 0.5-5.5 V in, 1 MHz synchronous boost, adjustable output 2.2-5.5 V, 3 A switch

decoupling.value: 4.7 uF effective ceramic CIN min 1 uF

layout_notes: Minimise length and area of SW trace; ground plane under regulator
Input cap close to VIN and GND pin
Output cap close to VOUT and GND; SW-FET to rectifier to COUT loop as short as possible
Make copper polygon on each pin larger for thermal performance
Feedback divider R1 (top) R2 (bottom), VOUT = 0.6 V x (1 + R1/R2) per datasheet equation; inductor effective 0.37-2.9 uH, 1 uH nominal
